newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait amends proposed 1997/98 budget, deficit up.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait amends proposed 1997/98 budget, deficit up.

text.p: Kuwait's government on Wednesday agreed with a parliamentary panel to amend its proposed budget for 1997/98 (July-June) increasing the projected net deficit to 1.26 billion dinars ($4.17 billion) from 1.17 billion, MPs said.

Parliament's Financial and Economic Affairs Committee in May rejected a budget proposal that accounted for revenue that could stem from a future rise in charges on some state services, a measure the requires parliament's approval.
Many MPs oppose any increase in charges on state services.

Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan has agreed to cut the proposed revenue by 92 million dinars which represent earnings from increasing fees on public utitlities, Nasser al-Sanea chairman of the committee, said after a committee meeting attended by Rodhan.
Wednesday's move would allow the committee to continue discusing the budget bill that could undergo other amendments before being debated by the full house.
The budget bill would be enacted retroactively after it gains the approval of parliament and the Emir, Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
The proposed bill projects state spending to be 4.37 billion dinars compared to 4.21 billion in the previous year's budget which projects a deficit of 1.21 billion dinars.
